data_point: Operates as a startup selling nationally
run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company operates as a startup rather than a small local business: it sells a software or technology product, or provably sells its services beyond its own metro area.
prompt.definition: This is the single most important discriminator on the profile. It cannot be true together with 'Local professional services firm'.
yes_when: The text clearly states a software or tech product (an app, platform, API, SaaS or software tool the company sells). Software counts as selling nationally: no proof of where its customers are is needed
A services firm whose text states customers beyond its own city or region (named clients elsewhere, 'nationwide', 'clients across the US')
no_when: The company sells its own billed labour into one metro area: agency, consultancy, contractor, clinic, single-location operation, and no software product is stated
unknown_when: Not enough text to tell whether it sells a software product
A services firm with no stated customers or service area
watch_out_for: Don't judge by how polished the site is
The software must be stated in the text, not guessed from design or wording like 'AI-powered'
A services firm needs stated proof of customers beyond its own city; national reach is never assumed for services

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Resend: email API for developers. Start for free. Plans from $20/mo. Trusted by teams worldwide.

output.evidence_quote: email API for developers. Start for free.
output.reason: A self-serve software product sold to developers anywhere.
